presenterNotes.reason: The frontend-slides skill (SKILL.md, html-template.md, animation-patterns.md, viewport-base.css) has no concept of a presenter/speaker-notes view, a second display/companion window, or a notes data model. It is a single self-contained HTML file meant to be presented directly. Narration text from script.json 'say' segments was therefore NOT embedded as hidden speaker notes anywhere in this deck — doing so would be fabricating a feature the skill does not define. This is an explicit, intentional limitation of this track, not an oversight.

knownLimitations: No presenter/speaker-notes mode (see presenterNotes above) — by design of the skill.
PDF export is a static snapshot only; animations, hover states, and inline editing are not preserved in the PDF (documented gotcha in SKILL.md 6B).

Upstream bug discovered in scripts/export-pdf.sh: when given a RELATIVE output path, the script's own internal `cd "$TEMP_DIR"` (done to install Playwright locally) causes the relative OUTPUT_PDF to resolve inside the temp directory, which is then deleted by the script's own cleanup step — the PDF is silently lost even though the script prints a success message and a file size. Workaround used here: pass an ABSOLUTE output path to the script. Not a bug in this deck's HTML/CSS/JS.

Card grids (e.g. slide 7 'Expose what the product already knows') have generous empty space beneath short body copy at 1920x1080 — a deliberate low-density/speaker-led choice per the user's implicit 11-slide talk-deck pacing, not an overflow defect.

Touch swipe logic is implemented but could not be exercised by an automated headless browser test (no real touch input in this environment); verified by code review against the skill's touch-nav pattern only.
